versions.content: If development error detection is enabled: the function shall check that the service V2xGn_Init was previously called. If the check fails, the function shall raise the development error V2XGN_E_UNINIT otherwise (if DET is disabled) return V2X_GNTX_E_UNSPECIFIED.
